title: The Legend of Zelda (NES) — Level 1 Recreation
coverAlt: Link facing Aquamentus and three fireballs in the recreated Eagle dungeon
description: A Unity recreation of the Eagle dungeon, plus an original seven-room Parry & Dash challenge.
role: Gameplay programming · Boomerang, Blade Trap, Parry & Dash
overview: Our two-person team recreated the first dungeon of the NES Legend of Zelda, including grid movement, room transitions, enemies, and the Aquamentus encounter. We then built a seven-room challenge that teaches parrying and dashing before combining both mechanics in a boss fight.

contributions.title: Boomerang
contributions.text: I implemented throwing and returning, limited active throws to one, and handled wall, room-boundary, and enemy interactions.

contributions.title: Blade Trap
contributions.text: I implemented directional detection, a wall-aware lunge, a slow return and cooldown, and damage on contact.

contributions.title: Parry and feedback
contributions.text: I implemented timing-based parries for enemy contact and projectiles. Three successful parries power up the sword, with a HUD counter and audio feedback to communicate progress.

contributions.title: Dash and Gold level access
contributions.text: I implemented the dash through enemies, added feedback sounds for the new actions and sword buff, and wired the keyboard shortcut to enter the custom level.
